recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Future profile refinements should occur in the EBM-on-FHIR IG, or in the FHIR Extension Pack for the related SiteRecruitment extension, unless BRR creates a new final tracker to move this content into core.
issue_request: The issue asked for a ResearchLocation profile of Location for research study sites, including a site recruitment status value set and contact details. Its final Jira state is Applied for R6 with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification, and the decisive resolution says to instead create a site profile of ResearchStudy.
initial_application: No core source commit mentioning FHIR-32317 was found, and the current core checkout has no ResearchLocation or ResearchStudySite profile source. Location and ResearchStudy are active core resources, but current core source does not add study-site recruitment semantics to Location. ResearchStudy supports site modeling through ResearchStudy.site and ResearchStudy.partOf, while the related SiteRecruitment extension definition is maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than as a core profile.
additional_context: FHIR-33000 was Resolved - No Change by Patient Administration, rejecting recruitment or enrollment status on Location or Organization and pointing the concept back to ResearchStudy. BRR minutes on 2025-03-13 state no R6 core action was required and suggest creating the site profile in an IG. Later BRR minutes on 2025-12-16 and 2026-01-06 show the ResearchStudySite profile being created and reviewed in the Evidence Based Medicine on FHIR IG, after which the Jira was marked Applied.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source was changed because creating a core Location profile would contradict the final resolution, the related FHIR-33000 no-change decision, and later BRR direction to house the ResearchStudySite profile in an external IG.

related_jiras.note: Rejected adding recruitmentStatus to Location or Organization and reinforced that site-specific study information belongs with ResearchStudy rather than core Location.
